## Project focus

::: {.grid-3}
::: {.skill-card}
### Visibility
Prioritize technical SEO, content, local search, and calls to action so people can find and understand Wellness Ranch.
:::
::: {.skill-card}
### Measurement
Define and validate GA4 events, key events, and KPIs for engagement, inquiries, phone interactions, and donations.
:::
::: {.skill-card}
### Activation
Prepare the organization for Google Ad Grants and a practical digital marketing strategy it can sustain after the project.
:::
:::

## Measurement framework

| Stage | Example KPI | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Acquisition | Sessions by traffic source | Shows where visitors originate |
| Engagement | Engagement rate and time | Shows interaction with content |
| Service interest | Program interactions and phone clicks | Signals potential service interest |
| Inquiries | Successful form submissions | Measures completed requests |
| Donations | Confirmed completed donations | Connects digital activity to fundraising |

## Next steps

1. Audit the current GA4 configuration and test important user journeys.
2. Create a measurement matrix linking objectives, events, validation methods, and reporting sources.
3. Compare baseline and post-implementation results with limitations documented.
4. Deliver a prioritized roadmap that Wellness Ranch can maintain.
